short_description: Volta Industrial — a heavy-equipment maker's downtime-and-maintenance rescue. Machine telemetry pushed a cluster of production lines into elevated failure risk with parts that would need expediting, faster than the nightly report could surface. A plant-floor app reads governed telemetry at low latency, a maintenance recommendation ranks the move (pull now / run to shift end / expedite parts and run) per at-risk line against downtime cost, and a plant lead approves — turning governed lakehouse data into a floor action, scoped to one plant, with the assistant's AI spend capped and predictable per plant across the fleet.
